skills.title: Modeling
skills.scope: whole UJG document modeling across Core, Graph, Surface and Experience, Runtime, Mapping, Metrics, Localization, Observability, Experience Annotation, and optional modules

skills.title: Core Modeling
skills.scope: Core module document containers, imports, top-level nodes, and extensions

skills.title: Graph Modeling
skills.scope: Graph module topology, journeys, states, transitions, exits, outgoing navigation, and indexes

skills.title: Design System Modeling
skills.scope: Design System module semantics and its relationship to Graph and Surface

skills.title: Localization Modeling
skills.scope: Localization module semantics for MessageMeta copy metadata, addressable Message values, Locale resources, and locale-switch metadata

skills.title: Observability Modeling
skills.scope: Observability module semantics for ObservationBinding, ObservationEvent input modality requirements, accessible-object locators, surface recognition contracts, and SurfaceInstanceResolver

skills.title: Domain Model Evaluation
skills.scope: Domain Model Document Extension evaluation against UJG topology, optional explicit domain knowledge, schema validity, traceability, minimality, alignment, assumptions, and realization neutrality
skills.description: Evaluate generated DomainModel outputs for the Editor's Draft against UJG topology, optional explicit domain knowledge, schema validity, traceability, minimality, alignment, assumptions, and realization neutrality.
skills.shortDescription: Evaluate UJG Domain Models for ED
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $ujg-ed-domain-model-evaluation to evaluate a generated DomainModel against the supplied UJG document, Domain Model JSON Schema, and any explicit domain knowledge.

skills.title: Domain Model Implementation Conformance
skills.scope: software implementation conformance against a full UJG document with the Domain Model Document Extension, including domain behavior, guarded branches, effects, invariants, and journey semantics
skills.description: Review or implement software against a User Journey Graph document with a Domain Model extension for the Editor's Draft, preserving domain behavior, guarded branches, effects, invariants, and journey semantics. Use when the full UJG document is the behavioral source of truth; do not use to evaluate the DomainModel JSON alone.
skills.shortDescription: Review UJG domain implementations for ED
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $ujg-ed-domain-model-implementation to review or implement software against a full UJG document with a Domain Model extension, including graph topology, guarded branches, effects, invariants, and journey semantics.
